correctness.rationale: Exact soft-model predictor f_q(y) follows by conditioning on the incoming type. Its Taylor remainder is summable in L2. The squared simple-walk occupation has mean log n+O(1), variance 4 log n+O(1), and an a.s. logarithmic law. A martingale transform yields its normalized Gaussian limit. Edge martingale has bracket q(1-q)n+o(n), and the mixed bracket of its sqrt(n) normalization with the occupation martingale normalized by sqrt(log n) tends to zero. Joint martingale CLT, Slutsky and the independent hard-model Bernoulli construction finish the proof. The standalone finite exact-rational checker passed 15,432 assertions, which do not substitute for proof.

value.rationale: The cross-community edge count is an intrinsic homophily/mixing observable of a recently studied two-community attachment mechanism. The hard and soft rules agree on the leading fraction and leading central-limit scale but the soft rule has an explicit sign-changing logarithmic finite-size bias and additional independent compensator fluctuations. This structural comparison is not supplied by known limiting degree distributions and matters for interpreting homophily at finite network sizes.
